scale.description: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Acropora millepora (385 µm, detail scale)

evolutionary_history.what_changes_at_this_node: This chronoseries has a single node, the extant Holocene crown at 0 Ma, so there is no in-series predecessor and no successor. Pigment does not fossilize, and the 385.2 µm wavelength is a crown-group reconstruction, not a measurement carried by the Eocene Acropora record (Wallace & Rosen 2006, DOI 10.1098/rspb.2005.3307), which documents colony-scale skeletal diversity. Relative to the adjacent smaller tier (calicoblast, ~10–20 µm) the primordium patch holds zero wavelengths of this mode; relative to a corallite diameter of about 1.5 mm the same k_c packs about four wavelengths, so this slot is the fundamental pigment wavelength rather than the corallite harmonic. Nothing in the series shifts the age: Δt = 0 and λ_c is stationary on the Holocene node.

pde: du/dt = a - u + u^2 v + D_u laplacian(u)
dv/dt = b - u^2 v + D_v laplacian(v)

state_variables.u: activator (short-range; mapped to host chromoprotein / GFP-like pigment density)

governing_equations.dispersion: sigma(k^2) = 0.5 * (tau + sqrt(tau^2 - 4 delta)), tau = tr(J) - k^2 (D_u+D_v), delta = det(J) - k^2 (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) + k^4 D_u D_v
governing_equations.selected_wavenumber: k_c = argmax_{k>0} sigma(k); lambda_c = 2 pi / k_c
governing_equations.band_center_not_used_as_target: k_Delta^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v) is the Murray band center. Above onset it is shorter than the fastest-growing mode; this slot tunes D_u so that argmax sigma, not k_Delta, equals 2 pi / 385.2 µm.
governing_equations.boundary_conditions: periodic on a square coenenchyme patch of side L = 8 * lambda_c = 3.0816 mm
governing_equations.initial_condition: uniform steady state plus Gaussian noise, RNG seed 3104

parameter_table.D_u_um2_per_s: solved so argmax sigma(k) has lambda = 385.2 µm
parameter_table.integration: explicit Euler, dt = 0.35 * dx^2 / (4 D_v), T = 45
parameter_table.note: These values are specific to slot 3104. They are not the integer scaling used by the colony-scale Acropora millepora Turing slot.

empirical_claims: Host GFP-like proteins, not the skeleton, make the conspicuous colour patterns of reef corals (Dove, Hoegh-Guldberg & Ranganathan 2001).
Coral fluorescent pigments are photoprotective (Salih et al. 2000) and, in Acropora millepora, blue light regulates host pigment (D'Angelo et al. 2008).
The 385.2 µm length is the assigned primordium-tier detail scale for this loop. It is not a published caliper measurement of A. millepora stripe spacing.
Linear theory places the fastest-growing wavelength at 385.2 µm; the nonlinear FFT on the 8-wavelength patch selects that same mode.
Equal diffusion (D_v = D_u) is below onset and the activator standard deviation decays.

specimen.creators: Petra Lundgren, Juan C. Vera, Lesa Peplow, Stephanie Manel and Madeleine J. H. van Oppen
specimen.what_it_shows: Great Barrier Reef colonies of Acropora millepora. Colony scale (centimetres), not a 385 µm micrograph. Used as the canonical CC-licensed specimen for computer-vision comparison.
